title: First hearing Papa Celestin's band around age 12
summary: At about 12 he first heard Celestin's band at a yacht club; he and his friends loved it and went to all the dances to hear it.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: When did you first become aware of the existence of such a form of music as New Orleans jazz?
Well, when I was about 12 years old, I heard for the first time Pop Selstein's band. And I believe it was the old Pestridge-Chan Yacht Club.
What did you think of the music?

Oh, I thought it was very good. I enjoyed it thoroughly. What about your friends? They all liked it, too. As a matter of fact, we used to make a point of going to all the dances that they had. To hear Pop Selstein.
